sentences.text: The documents do not state any RBI monetary penalty for a UCB that levies prohibited foreclosure charges.

They state only that pre-payment charges are not to be levied in the cases covered by para 261(1), para 261(2)(ii), para 261(6), and any charge not disclosed as specified shall not be charged by a UCB.
For cases outside para 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, are as per the approved policy of a UCB, and term-loan charges, if levied, are based on the amount being prepaid.
The withdrawn 2014 foreclosure-charge circular and the withdrawn 2025 pre-payment-charges directions do not provide an in-force penalty amount for 2026-11-23.

missing.slot: monetary penalty imposed by RBI for levying prohibited foreclosure charges
missing.searched: RBI directions on pre-payment/foreclosure charges and withdrawn circulars
